name: Ur of the Chaldeans
info: Abraham's birthplace, the starting point of his journey.

name: Haran
info: The city where Abraham and his family stayed before heading to Canaan.

name: Shechem
info: The first place Abraham stopped in Canaan and built an altar.

name: Bethel
info: The place where Jacob saw the dream of the ladder reaching to heaven.

name: Hebron (Cave of Machpelah)
info: The burial place of the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

name: Beersheba
info: The site of the covenant between Abraham and Abimelech.

name: Gerar
info: Where Abraham and Isaac stayed and dealt with Abimelech, king of the Philistines.

name: Dothan
info: The place where Joseph was sold by his brothers.

name: Moreh
info: Where the Lord first appeared to Abraham in the land of Canaan.

name: Sodom and Gomorrah
info: The cities destroyed because of their great sin.

name: Mount Moriah
info: Where Abraham offered his son Isaac as a sacrifice (later site of the Temple).

name: Peniel
info: Where Jacob wrestled with God face to face.

name: Land of Goshen (Egypt)
info: The region where the Israelites lived in Egypt.

name: Rameses
info: The store city built by the Israelites and the starting point of the Exodus.

name: Succoth
info: The first stop after leaving Rameses.

name: Marah
info: Where they found bitter water and Moses turned it sweet.

name: Elim
info: A place with 12 springs and 70 palm trees.

name: Rephidim
info: Site of the battle with Amalek and water coming out of the rock.

name: Mount Sinai
info: The place where Moses received the Ten Commandments.

name: Kadesh Barnea
info: The place from which the spies set out to explore Canaan.

name: Mount Hor
info: The place where Aaron the priest died.

name: Mount Nebo
info: The place from which Moses saw the Promised Land before his death.

name: Jericho
info: The first city conquered by Joshua after entering Canaan.

name: Ai
info: The city where the Israelites were first defeated then conquered.

name: Gibeon
info: The city that deceived Joshua into a treaty, and where the sun stood still.

name: Hazor
info: The head of all those kingdoms in the north which Joshua burned.

name: Shiloh
info: The site of the Tabernacle for many years before the building of the Temple.

name: Gibeah
info: Home of Saul, the first king of Israel.

name: Dan
info: The northern limit of the land of Israel and where Jeroboam placed a golden calf.

name: Beth Shan
info: Where the Philistines hung the body of King Saul.

name: Jerusalem (City of David)
info: The capital captured by David from the Jebusites.

name: Baal Perazim
info: Where David defeated the Philistines like the breakthrough of waters.

name: Samaria
info: Capital of the northern kingdom of Israel.

name: Mount Carmel
info: Site of Elijah's challenge to the prophets of Baal.

name: Jezreel
info: Where Ahab's palace and Naboth's vineyard were located.

name: Babylon
info: The city of the Babylonian exile.

name: Nineveh
info: Capital of Assyria where the prophet Jonah went.

name: Tirzah
info: Early capital of the kingdom of Israel before Samaria.

name: Megiddo
info: Site of historical battles and the symbolic site of 'Armageddon'.

name: Shushan (Susa)
info: Site of events in the books of Esther, Nehemiah, and Daniel.

name: Ecbatana
info: Capital of Media where Cyrus's decree was found.

name: Bethlehem
info: City of David and birthplace of the Savior.

name: Nazareth
info: The city where Jesus Christ grew up.

name: Capernaum
info: The center of Jesus' ministry in Galilee.

name: Sea of Galilee
info: Where Jesus walked on water and calmed the storm.

name: Cana of Galilee
info: Site of the miracle of turning water into wine.

name: Bethany
info: Village of Lazarus, Mary, and Martha, and site of Lazarus' resurrection.

name: Garden of Gethsemane
info: Where Jesus prayed before his betrayal.

name: Golgotha
info: The site of the crucifixion of Jesus Christ.

name: Emmaus
info: Where Jesus appeared to two disciples after his resurrection.

name: Bethsaida
info: Home of Peter, Andrew, and Philip.

name: Chorazin
info: One of the cities Jesus rebuked for not repenting.

name: Joppa
info: Place of Peter's vision and Tabitha's resurrection.

name: Damascus
info: The road where the Lord appeared to Saul (Paul).

name: Antioch
info: Where the believers were first called Christians.

name: Ephesus
info: An important city in Asia Minor visited by Paul and John.

name: Philippi
info: The first European city where Paul preached.

name: Thessalonica
info: Center of Paul's preaching in Macedonia.

name: Athens
info: Paul's speech at the Areopagus.

name: Corinth
info: A Greek city to which Paul wrote two epistles.

name: Rome
info: The capital of the empire and the site of Peter and Paul's martyrdom.

name: Patmos
info: The place of John's exile and where the Book of Revelation was written.

name: Smyrna
info: One of the seven churches of Revelation.

name: Pergamum
info: One of the seven churches of Revelation.

name: Thyatira
info: One of the seven churches of Revelation and home of Lydia.

name: Sardis
info: One of the seven churches of Revelation.

name: Philadelphia
info: One of the seven churches of Revelation.

name: Laodicea
info: One of the seven churches of Revelation.

name: Abraham's Journey
info: The long route of Abraham's journey from Ur to Canaan.

name: Exodus Route
info: The approximate route of the Israelites' Exodus from Egypt to Canaan.

name: Paul's Journey to Rome
info: The sea route of the Apostle Paul's journey as a prisoner to Rome.
